title: Star
desc: Murthy earns his living by going to jail for the mistakes of other people. He agrees to act as Ramanathan's son, Santhosh, who is wanted dead by Dhanushkodi.

title: Manu Needhi
desc: In a bid to seek revenge for a past misdeed, a man asks his nephew to woo the daughter of his enemy. However, complications arise when his nephew really falls in love with the girl.

title: Maravan
desc: When police officer Sethupathi is transferred to a village, he learns about the complete lack of law and order in his jurisdiction. Unperturbed, he decides to turn things around and establish peace.

title: Kunguma Pottu Gounder
desc: Kandasamy is desperate to enrol his son in a good school. Trouble ensues when his wife spots him with an educated woman who is posing as their child's mother in order to help him get admission.

title: Kannupada Poguthaiya
desc: Vetrivel, a respected man, dearly loves his brother and sacrifices his love for him. Problems arise when his brother, Subramaniyam, starts suspecting him of having an affair with his wife Gowri.
